# pljung.de

> > Philipp Jung's personal site covering data engineering expertise, technical documentation, and reflections on software development and personal growth.

pljung.de is the portfolio and blog of Philipp Jung, a Senior Data Engineer based in Berlin. The site features technical guides on data warehousing and cloud infrastructure, alongside personal essays on teamwork, learning, and professional development.

## Key Topics

- Data Engineering
- BigQuery
- Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
- Data Warehousing
- Firestore
- JavaScript & React
- Python
- Backup Strategies
- Developer Productivity
- Technical Writing
- Berlin
- Tabular Data Formats
- Cloud Storage
- Machine Learning
- Best Practices

## About & Professional Background

- [Philipp Jung – Data Engineer, Berlin](https://pljung.de): Homepage of Philipp Jung, Senior Data Engineer in Berlin.
- [About](https://pljung.de/about): About Philipp Jung: Senior Data Engineer at Contentful, Berlin.

## Data Engineering & Warehousing

- [Efficient Data Export from Firestore to BigQuery](https://pljung.de/posts/export-firestore-to-bigquery): Guide to transferring data from Firestore to BigQuery efficiently.
- [Currency Conversion In A Data Warehouse](https://pljung.de/posts/currency-conversion-data-warehouse): Currency conversion patterns in BigQuery data warehouses.
- [Tabular Data Transferring Patterns](https://pljung.de/posts/tabular-data-transferring-patterns): Patterns for transferring and loading tabular data in pipelines.
- [Escaping the CSV Trap and Embracing Alternatives](https://pljung.de/posts/escaping-the-csv-trap): Data format alternatives to CSV: Parquet, Feather, and Avro.

## Infrastructure, Backup & DevOps

- [Synology Backup in Google Cloud Storage Archives](https://pljung.de/posts/synology-backup-gcs-archive): NAS backup strategy using Synology DS223j and Google Cloud.
- [Automating Backups With Btrbk On Fedora 34](https://pljung.de/posts/btrbk-fedora-34): Guide to automating backups with Btrbk on Fedora 34.

## Programming & Developer Tools

- [Mutable Objects in JavaScript](https://pljung.de/posts/mutable-objects-react): JavaScript mutability and state management in React applications.
- [Finding the Closest Element in a Sorted Array](https://pljung.de/posts/closest-integer-in-a-list): Algorithm optimization for finding closest array element.
- [I Underestimated The Importance of Tooling](https://pljung.de/posts/importance-of-tooling): Developer tools comparison: VS Code, Neovim, and productivity.
- [Zeal and Dash for Reading Developer Documentation](https://pljung.de/posts/zeal-and-dash-for-reading-developer-documentation): Using Zeal and Dash for offline developer documentation access.
- [Learning Relaxations](https://pljung.de/posts/learning-relaxations): Master's thesis summary on relaxed functional dependencies.

## Personal Essays & Reflections

- [The smartest Person in a Jazz Band: Thoughts on Working in a Team](https://pljung.de/posts/jazz-band): Reflections on teamwork and collaboration inspired by Chad Fowler.
- [Languages, Fast and Slow](https://pljung.de/posts/languages-fast-and-slow): Programming language performance philosophy and optimization.
- [Going Wired](https://pljung.de/posts/going-wired): Improving video conferencing quality with wired Ethernet setup.
- [Trust](https://pljung.de/posts/trust): Personal essay on trust and performance pressure in rock climbing.
